name: B10-0184/2024 (ECR) – Georgia's worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Georgia’s worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
part_text:
The European Parliament says Georgia's October 2024 election results should not be trusted, because observers found widespread fraud and pressure on voters. It asks the European Union to cut off high-level contact with Georgia's government and parliament, freeze technical cooperation, redirect about 120 million euros a year from the government to civil society and independent media, and impose travel bans and sanctions on ruling party officials and the oligarch Bidzina Ivanishvili. It also calls for former President Mikheil Saakashvili's release.

- The EU is asked to suspend high-level talks and cooperation with Georgia's government and parliament.
- EU money for Georgia's government would go to civil society and media instead.
- Travel bans and sanctions are urged against Georgian Dream officials and Ivanishvili.
